svg.text: Every instruction’s length is fixed by its opcode byte, so this table is the whole decoder.
Cycles are the no-page-crossing case: + adds one when an indexed address crosses a page, ++ is a branch (+1 taken, +2 taken across a page).
Generated from isa/mos6502.toml by tools/gen-6502-map.js. Counts are of documented opcodes.
